chunks: Who created me and He guides me,
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between God's act of creation and His act of guidance in the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse, part of the dialogue between Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and the disbelievers in Surah Ash-Shu'ara, serves as a concise theological proof of God's continuous care for His creation. In Shia exegesis, it underscores the concept of 'Tawhid al-Af'al' (Oneness of Divine Actions), affirming that the Creator is not only the originator of existence but also the active guide who sustains and directs the servant toward spiritual perfection.
